name: Deuteronomy
author: Traditionally Moses, with an account of his death added.
date: Traditionally set just before Israel enters the land, about 1400 to 1200 BC.
setting: Israel on the plains of Moab, with the Jordan ahead of them.
theme: Love the Lord with all your heart, obey him, and remember what he has done.

outline.label: Second address: the call to love and obey
Ebal and Gerizim, and the curses

christInBook: Moses promises a prophet like himself (18:15), and the New Testament identifies him as Jesus. Jesus answered every temptation in the wilderness with words from this book, and Paul says Christ became a curse for us (Galatians 3:13, quoting Deuteronomy 21:23).
howToRead: Deuteronomy is a sermon, not a law code. Notice the repeated words “remember,” “hear,” “today,” and “love.” The book’s pattern follows ancient covenant documents: history, commands, blessings and curses, and witnesses.
